listeners.doc: Polls the configured SQS queue and dispatches each received message to the attached service.

serviceTypes.doc: Consumes messages received from the polled SQS queue.

options.name: onMessage
options.doc: Invoked once per message received from the polled queue. The listener requests one message at a time and waits for this call to return before polling again, so there is no batching to configure. Set @sqs:ServiceConfig { autoDelete: false } to take over deletion explicitly through the caller parameter instead of the listener's automatic delete-after-receive behavior.

params.name: message
params.doc: The received message: its body, message and receipt IDs, and any system or user-defined attributes requested for the poll.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for explicitly deleting the message from the queue. Needed only when @sqs:ServiceConfig { autoDelete: false } is set; otherwise the listener deletes the message automatically once this handler returns.

options.name: onError
options.doc: Invoked when a received message cannot be dispatched to onMessage, most commonly because the declared parameter types do not match sqs:Message or sqs:Caller, or because an automatic delete after onMessage fails.

params.name: err
params.doc: The failure that prevented dispatch or the post-processing delete.
